verdict.rationale: Nix documents core caching primitives that support fast CI installs — transparent binary caching (nix-docs-36, nix-docs-52), atomic add-only store operations (nix-docs-50, nix-docs-54), and remote builds (nix-docs-30) — and community evidence corroborates real-world speedups from shared binary caches/remote builders (nix-comm-9). However there is no documented CI-specific cache-restore setup guide (e.g., GitHub Actions caching action, cache key/restore semantics) and no explicit documentation of offline-capable installs once caches/store are populated. missing for 10: dedicated CI cache-restore/action documentation, explicit offline-install guarantees, independent benchmark of CI install speed.
